summary: This is a Reveal.js presentation slide that displays a question asking if the viewer wants to see a candy dog, followed by an image of a candy dog that animates in with a fade-up effect when the slide is revealed.

explanations.3: This creates a styled text block using Reveal.js syntax; the style attribute sets the font size to 2em (twice the normal size) and the text color to a light blue (#75AADB).
explanations.7: This wraps the image in a Reveal.js fragment with two effects: 'fragment' means it won't appear until you advance, and 'fade-up' makes it smoothly fade in while sliding upward.
